description: Parking hors voirie is a dataset listed in DataHub Métropole de Bordeaux open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Bordeaux Métropole. Dictionnaire Public Ce jeu de données représente par un ponctuel la localisation des principaux parkings payants ouverts au public et parcs relais présents sur le territoire de Bordeaux Métropole, qu'ils soient de gestion publique ou privée. Il fournit des données sur leurs caractéristiques administratives, techniques et tarifaires (gestionnaire, nombre et types de places, tarifs types). Coverage: Bordeaux Métropole. The portal files it under Transports/mobilité. Its keywords are tarifs, Circulation, Stationnement, parkings, mobilité, ouvrage. The portal shows 100 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-datahub-bordeaux-metropole-fr-portal.
